body:
Owner requests designer exploration using Hermes designer profile. DESIGN ONLY; no implementation or release approval. Current server/targets.ts uses BMR times usual-activity multiplier then weight-goal adjustment; Apple Health active energy includes movement and exercise, not workout-only. Never add all active calories on top of this baseline or claim exact measured activity already included.
Deliver two mobile-first live-gallery variants and recommendation, extending existing Paper/Night journal design. Explore usual target, explicit user-confirmed training-day adjustment, adjusted target/eaten/remaining hierarchy, visible Movement + exercise block with source/update time and expandable explanation. Show normal day, hard/long workout, suggested-but-unconfirmed adjustment, confirmed adjustment, undo/edit, missing/stale Health and manual goal cases. Actual workout information may inform suggestions but must not silently change budgets. Separate nutrition-policy questions from visual proposal: source-backed rationale, uncertainty, baseline overlap, intensity/duration, missing data, safe wording; no invented clinical formula, arbitrary kcal prescription or green-ring claim of adequate fuelling. Example adjustments are labelled illustrative, not validated recommendations. Include future unsupported states as design only.
Use two cohesive variants, both themes, phone-size previews, accessible readable activity figure, minimal helper text with expandable details, food illustrations matching approved library. Provide interaction prototype, screenshots, reproducible artifacts, state/decision matrix, and implementation-ready spec with unresolved policy questions plainly marked. Coordinate #223 row artwork but do not modify its lane or app sources. Stop at design approval; no app code, schema, deployment or main changes. Refs #198.

Cross-link #228: tactile-journal exploration should align visual hierarchy, terminology and future activity-area extensibility with this concept. This is alignment, not resumption: training-day fuelling policy and adjustment flow remain parked pending explicit approval.
